sources: Flare 2.0 练后 专项补强 + Flare2 2026-11-21（Google 表 1aCseEk4vslsG-QKb-zsZwg30amvoYh5tMxzy6p9n8vA，Flare2：地面团身支撑（双手撑地面，不用瑜伽砖））

purpose.zh: 双手直接撑地面，把身体撑离地、收腿悬空，练直臂下压和收腹，为 L 撑打底
purpose.en: Hands flat on the floor, press your body up and tuck your legs off the mat. Builds straight-arm pressing and the ab tuck for the L-sit.

text.zh: 手臂锁直，把地往下推，臀和脚都离地
text.en: Arms locked, push the floor down, hips and feet up

text.zh: 坐在垫上，手掌平放在髋两侧的垫子上，手指朝前。
text.en: Sit on the mat, palms flat beside your hips, fingers forward.

text.zh: 肩往下压，先把屁股撑离地，再把膝盖收向胸口、两脚离地。
text.en: Press your shoulders down, lift your hips first, then draw your knees in and lift your feet.

text.zh: 上身可以稍微前倾，臀离地几厘米就够。
text.en: Lean slightly forward; a few centimetres of hip clearance is enough.

commonErrors.en: Lifting only the legs while the hips stay on the floor.

cautions.zh: 手腕疼就停；撑不起来先用砖或厚书垫高手（团身 L 撑）
cautions.en: Stop if your wrists hurt; if you cannot lift off, raise your hands on blocks or books first (tuck L-sit).

flare2.item: Flare2：地面团身支撑（双手撑地面，不用瑜伽砖）
flare2.camera: 右前方 48°（看得到手撑地面、臀离地、脚离地）
flare2.doseBrief: 表：静态保持；草稿 10 秒 × 3 组、休 60 秒（待定）
flare2.note: Animation r3 2b: palms flat on the mat beside the hips (no blocks); seated -> arms lock and shoulders press down (hips 4.6 cm off the mat, trunk leans ~7 deg) -> knees drawn in, feet 3 cm off (knees ~81 deg) -> hold ~4.5 s -> feet and hips down. 8 s loop, symmetric.

set.zh: 手臂锁直，肩往下压，臀和脚离地
set.en: Arms locked, shoulders down, hips and feet up
